Nu's controller is right =)

> Can i use the .44 maneuver under lapse?

no. You're commited to strike with the .44, that is, when you say i maneuver
with .44 you are actually declaring your strike. It's about the same thing
as saying "i play this thrown grate here just for the maneuver even if i
can't strike with it".

> Can i use the .44 maneuver under Hidden Lurker?

nope. No strike, no .44 maneuver.

> Can i use the .44 maneuver under Fast Reaction?

nope. No strike, no .44 maneuver.
